auth.label: API Key
auth.description: BigMailer REST API key sent in the X-API-Key header. Create or view API keys from the BigMailer API documentation and account settings: https://docs.bigmailer.io/.

actions.name: create_contact
actions.description: Create a contact in a BigMailer brand.

validate.description: Whether BigMailer should validate email deliverability before adding the contact.

string.description: The text value for this field.

integer.description: The integer value for this field.

date.description: The date value for this field.

items.description: A BigMailer contact field value. Exactly one of string, integer, or date must be provided.

fieldValues.description: Field values to save with the contact. Each name must match a BigMailer field tag name.

listIds.description: IDs of lists the contact should belong to.

unsubscribeAll.description: Whether to unsubscribe the contact from all future campaigns regardless of message type.

unsubscribeIds.description: IDs of message types the contact should be unsubscribed from.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for creating a BigMailer contact.

anyOf.description: The affected BigMailer object ID.

outputSchema.description: The BigMailer ID result returned by the mutation.
